subject: Re: Redwood Inference \u2014 procurement & billing details (invoice format, net terms)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-10T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood Inference — procurement & billing follow-up

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the call today — great to hear more about Acme's roadmap and where inference fits in. Per our discussion, quick recap and a few items to help us land the commercial path: 

Key recap from call:
- You expect initial usage to be for the recommendations pilot (low token volume) with ramp to production in Q3.
- Procurement runway: finance requires an internal PO for any vendor over $10k and prefers net-30; they sometimes accept card for pilot purchases under $5k.
- Marketplace interest: you mentioned SSO/marketplace procurement via your cloud marketplace team is a possibility but will require separate contracting.

Can you confirm:
1) Will Acme proceed via PO or card for the pilot?
2) If PO, who is the procurement contact (name/email) and what's the expected lead time for issuing a PO?
3) Any specific invoice requirements (e.g., tax/VAT lines, purchase order number placement, billing address, remit-to format)?

I've attached our standard invoice template and a short SOC 2 summary that procurement often requests. Happy to jump on a 15-min call with your procurement lead to speed this along.

Next steps we propose:
- You share procurement contact + preferred path (PO vs card) by end of week
- We prepare a commercial summary and draft order form for signature
- If marketplace required, loop in Nikhil to map technical integrations

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-invoice-template.pdf, soc2-summary-2026.pdf

From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2027-03-11T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — procurement & billing follow-up

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming answers from procurement: 
- For the pilot we'll likely pay by card if the total stays < $5k. For anything above that threshold we'll request a PO.
- Procurement lead is Tom Reynolds (tom.reynolds@acme-corp.com), he owns vendor setup and PO issuance. Typical PO turnaround is ~7-10 business days once we have the order form and a vendor W-9 / tax info.
- Invoice requirements:
  - Please include our PO number when provided in the invoice header
  - Billing address: Acme Corp, Accounts Payable, 400 Market St, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94105
  - Remit-to: your standard remit address is fine (we'll need that on the invoice)
  - Tax: Acme is not tax-exempt; include any VAT/tax lines if applicable.

Tom and procurement@acme-corp.com are looped in — Tom, can you confirm W-9 requirement and whether we need a specific invoice format (PDF vs XML) on our AP portal?

Sofia
Sofia Martinez
Head of Product (Recommendations)
Acme Corp
sofia.martinez@acme-corp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-corp.com>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2027-03-12T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — Redwood invoice + vendor setup

Thanks Tom / Sofia — helpful. A couple quick clarifications so our billing ops can prepare: 

1) W-9: we'll attach our W-9 and remit details. (Attached: redwood-invoice-template.pdf includes remit lines; SOC2 summary included earlier).
2) PDF is preferred for invoices — we can also provide a CSV summary if your portal needs a bulk import.
3) PO placement: we'll include a specific PO number field in the invoice header when you provide it.
4) Net terms: our standard is net-30 for enterprise orders; we can confirm net-30 in the order form and support net-45/60 only via an explicit credit review.

Action items from our side:
- I attached the invoice template we use for PO billing.
- Nikhil will prepare a short commercial summary and order form reflecting net-30 terms and a placeholder PO field.
- If you prefer card for the pilot, we can invoice the card immediately and then transition to PO for production.

If you want, we can set a 15-min sync with Tom + our billing ops (Rachel) tomorrow to finalize invoice fields. When works for you?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-invoice-template.pdf

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — Redwood invoice + vendor setup

Marissa / team —

Quick answers from procurement: 
- We accept PDF invoices. Our AP portal prefers: invoice PDF + a separate CSV for line-level detail for imports, but the PDF is mandatory.
- Please include the PO number in the invoice header. If a PO isn't issued at time of invoice, include a "Pending PO" note and we will match when issued.
- Billing address confirmed as Sofia listed. Remit-to should match the remit lines in your template.
- W-9: yes, upload to our vendor portal or attach to the vendor setup email.
- Net terms: we typically do net-30 on vendor contracts of this size. If Redwood requires different terms, we'll route for approval but net-30 is standard.

Next steps:
- Marissa: please send final order form and W-9 to procurement@acme-corp.com.
- Rachel: if you can join a quick 15-min call tomorrow at 10am PT to confirm invoice fields and sample PDF, that would help close the vendor setup.

Thanks —
Tom Reynolds
Vendor Management, Acme Corp
procurement@acme-corp.com
